gamerule.description.advance_time: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Advance the day/night phase naturally; explicit time commands remain available.
gamerule.description.advance_weather: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Advance natural weather timers and let sleep clear weather; explicit weather commands remain available.
gamerule.description.allow_entering_neth: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Allow Nether portal entry. MinecraftC has no Nether portal system.
gamerule.description.block_drops: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Allow mined blocks, container contents and explosion-destroyed blocks to drop items.
gamerule.description.block_explosion_dro: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Reduce drops from block-origin explosions other than TNT. No such explosions currently exist.
gamerule.description.command_blocks_work: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Enable command blocks; command blocks are not implemented.
gamerule.description.command_block_outpu: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Send command block execution feedback; command blocks are not implemented.
gamerule.description.drowning_damage: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Allow drowning damage to the player; breathing and other damage continue independently.
gamerule.description.elytra_movement_che: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Enable server Elytra movement validation; no Elytra or multiplayer validation exists. Legacy disableElytraMovementCheck is inverted.
gamerule.description.ender_pearls_vanish: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Remove thrown Ender pearls when their owner dies; Ender pearls are not implemented.
gamerule.description.entity_drops: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Allow non-mob entities such as boats and minecarts to drop items when destroyed; these entities are absent.
gamerule.description.fall_damage: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Allow player fall damage.
gamerule.description.fire_damage: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Allow player fire and lava damage. Does not prevent ignition or damage to mobs.
gamerule.description.fire_spread_radius_: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Fire aging/spreading radius: 0 stops fire ticks, -1 removes the distance limit. Only loaded edited fire is modeled; up to 256 fires tick per pass. doFireTick false/true sets 0/128; allowFireTicksAwayFromPlayer true/false sets -1/128. Last write wins.
gamerule.description.forgive_dead_player: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Neutral mobs forgive dead players; neutral-mob anger is not implemented.
gamerule.description.freeze_damage: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Allow powder-snow freezing damage; freezing is not implemented.
gamerule.description.global_sound_events: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Broadcast distant global events; no global sound event system exists.
gamerule.description.immediate_respawn: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Respawn automatically through the normal respawn flow without the death screen.
gamerule.description.keep_inventory: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Keep all inventory slots, armor and offhand on death; otherwise drop them normally. No XP system exists.
gamerule.description.lava_source_convers: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Allow supported flowing lava between two source neighbors to become a source.
gamerule.description.limited_crafting: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Restrict crafting to unlocked recipes; recipe unlocking is not implemented.
gamerule.description.locator_bar: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Show multiplayer locator bar; multiplayer tracking is not implemented.
gamerule.description.log_admin_commands: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Log successful local mutating command types through the logger; no server administration broadcast exists.
gamerule.description.max_block_modificat: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Limit blocks modified by fill/clone; these commands are absent.
gamerule.description.max_command_forks: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Limit execute command forks. Official 1.21.11 binary accepts 0; execute is absent.
gamerule.description.max_command_sequenc: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Limit command-chain length; command chains are absent.
gamerule.description.max_entity_cramming: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Limit crowded entities before suffocation; entity cramming is not implemented.
gamerule.description.max_minecart_speed: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Experimental Minecart Improvements rule, included in the baseline registry; minecarts are absent.
gamerule.description.max_snow_accumulati: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): 0 disables new snow accumulation. Values 1–8 permit one existing snow layer; stacked snow layers are absent.
gamerule.description.mob_drops: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Allow mob death loot. Player inventory loss and existing dropped items are independent.
gamerule.description.mob_explosion_drop_: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Reduce Blastling explosion block drops with probability 1/explosion power.
gamerule.description.mob_griefing: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Allow Blastling explosions to destroy blocks; explosion damage still applies. Other Java mob block interactions are absent.
gamerule.description.natural_health_rege: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Allow food-based natural healing. Hunger depletion and starvation continue independently.
gamerule.description.player_movement_che: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Enable multiplayer movement validation; no multiplayer validation exists. Legacy disablePlayerMovementCheck is inverted.
gamerule.description.players_nether_port: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Creative Nether portal delay in ticks; Nether portals are absent.
الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Default Nether portal delay in ticks; Nether portals are absent.
gamerule.description.players_sleeping_pe: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Single-player sleep skips the night when the percentage is at most 100. Higher values prevent the skip. Heaven travel is independent.
gamerule.description.projectiles_can_bre: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Allow projectile destruction of supported fragile blocks; such projectile interactions are absent.
gamerule.description.pvp: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Allow player-versus-player combat; multiplayer is absent.
gamerule.description.raids: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Enable raids; raids are absent. Legacy disableRaids is inverted.
gamerule.description.random_tick_speed: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Random draws per 16-cubed section each 20 Hz tick, default 3. Only edited farmland, wheat and saplings are modeled within 128 horizontal blocks. 0 stops these updates; fluids/furnaces continue. At most 16384 draws per tick; excess is capped with rotating section priority.
gamerule.description.reduced_debug_info: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Hide coordinates, chunk counts and GI statistics from the gameplay window title; FPS remains visible.
gamerule.description.respawn_radius: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Search up to 16 safe loaded columns in the horizontal square around world spawn; otherwise use world spawn. Valid beds override the radius.
gamerule.description.send_command_feedba: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Show successful command feedback. Queries/help/errors and support warnings remain visible; toggling this rule acknowledges once.
gamerule.description.show_advancement_me: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Announce advancements; advancements are absent.
gamerule.description.show_death_messages: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Show the local player death message without changing the death or respawn flow.
gamerule.description.spawner_blocks_work: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Enable spawner blocks; spawners are absent.
gamerule.description.spawn_mobs: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Allow natural mob spawning and first-load village population in the Overworld. Existing entities and spawn eggs are independent. Re-enabling retries pending population without duplicating loaded entities.
gamerule.description.spawn_monsters: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Allow natural hostile spawning. Does not delete existing hostiles or block spawn eggs.
gamerule.description.spawn_patrols: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Enable patrol spawning; patrols are absent.
gamerule.description.spawn_phantoms: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Enable phantom spawning; phantoms are absent.
gamerule.description.spawn_wandering_tra: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Enable wandering trader spawning; wandering traders are absent.
gamerule.description.spawn_wardens: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Enable Warden spawning; Wardens are absent.
gamerule.description.spectators_generate: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Allow ordinary spectator movement to advance terrain streaming. Loading and explicit teleport commands still run their loading pipeline; terrain LOD remains active.
gamerule.description.spread_vines: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Allow vine growth; vine random growth is absent.
gamerule.description.tnt_explodes: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Allow primed TNT to explode at the end of its fuse; disabled TNT disappears without an explosion.
gamerule.description.tnt_explosion_drop_: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Reduce TNT block drops with probability 1/explosion power when true, default false. Explosion drops remain capped at 32 stacks.
gamerule.description.universal_anger: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Share neutral-mob anger with all players; neutral anger is absent.
gamerule.description.water_source_conver: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): Allow supported flowing water between two source neighbors to become a source.
gamerule.description.DayNightDuration: الشرح التفصيلي (بالإنجليزية): MinecraftC extension: day/night duration in seconds, 1–4294967295. Also accepts minecraftc:day_night_duration.
